verdict.rationale: First-party Seer docs show in-product AI insights from the user's own data. Autofix scans incoming issues to find root causes and automate triage, Seer Agent answers any question about the application by finding the relevant telemetry, and Autofix can generate code-fix suggestions and PRs. The homepage reinforces this with "automatically root-cause any issue" and Seer as the debugging agent. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Seer's insight quality; all evidence is vendor-claimed.
